firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently mixed ingredients of any kind starts the first round. Turns then proceed clockwise.
clarifications: In later rounds, the player with the fewest cubes on Achievement cards starts; if tied, the tied player farthest clockwise from the previous round's first player starts.
The team variant uses the same turn order, with teams taking turns.
